case.summary: 3 transaction(s) totalling $700.22 on C09195-K1 are assessed as fraud (probability 0.92), matching an undocumented pattern. The activity stems from a single rare device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) that, during the burst from 2016-11-14 to 2016-12-04, transacted on 28 different cards. In every transaction the device appears as New for the account and operates behind an anonymous proxy; the purchases are ordinary online amounts and the bank’s risk scores stay low, so no single transaction looks alarming. This pattern was uncovered by expanding from the flagged transaction to its device and counting distinct cards, revealing that the same device profile links 27 other cards, which is treated as a coordinated ring rather than an isolated compromise. Trigger: risk score. Tool calls: 10; closed cases consulted: CC-3035, CC-2985, CC-2971.

sar.narrative: Who: customer C09195, holder of visa debit card C09195-K1, is the subject of this report. What: 3 online transactions totalling $700.22 were made on the card between 2016-11-26 and 2016-12-02 in billing region 184, 225 and are not consistent with the cardholder's history. How: every suspicious transaction on this card came from one device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080), recorded as New for the account and behind an anonymous proxy. The same device profile transacted on 27 other cards in the same burst (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2, C06650-K2, C06710-K1, C07472-K1, C08168-K1, C08972-K2, C09049-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10020-K1, C10193-K2, C10326-K1, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C11702-K1, C12645-K1, C12796-K1, C13291-K1, C13487-K1). Individual amounts are ordinary and the bank's risk scores stayed low, so the activity is visible only by linking cards through the shared device. Why suspicious: one device working many unrelated card numbers, always as a new device behind an anonymous proxy, indicates a single actor using many compromised cards. The activity matches previously confirmed fraud cases (CC-3035, CC-2985, CC-2971). Assessment: fraud probability 0.92 from a calibrated model over the card's history and graph evidence; the bank's own risk score on the flagged transaction was 0.21. The card is to be blocked and reissued and 27 connected cards placed under monitoring; the case is recorded in the investigation graph for future analysts, and this report is filed because the activity meets the reporting threshold.
